Expired cutoff is final date before October 13 Pacific; active multi-day/seasonal listings retained. Expired October 9 Finley occurrence removed, seven remaining approved dates preserved; remaining Balletto dates October 15, 22 and 29 preserved.

Recurring outdoor walks and markets expanded only through December 2026 using current official weekday/season schedules. Explicitly dated observatory programs extend through December 2027; UTC ticket timestamps converted to Pacific dates.

All 31 source URLs were attempted; successful HTTP responses alone are not treated as full verification. Sources and individual links with access restrictions are documented. No unverified Evvnt candidates added.
